remarks: A once-in-a-generation waterfront opportunity in Old Greenwich, CT. Nestled above the tranquil waters of Greenwich Cove, 1 Hendrie Drive Extension captures breathtaking sunsets, expansive water views, and direct access to ''The Cove'' and Long Island Sound. With a private dock, elevated setting, and extraordinary natural surroundings, this property offers a lifestyle rarely available on Connecticut's Gold Coast. Just moments from the village, train, beaches, and schools, it is the perfect blend of waterfront serenity and everyday convenience. Truly one of Old Greenwich's most distinctive and irreplaceable properties. Mailbox reads: 1 Cove Ridge Ln. This home is being sold As-Is.
